Fire Hydrant Flow and Pressure Test Report 13 checkpoints across 5 sections.Following installation and before handover of fire hydrant systems; repeated annually for maintenance verification Download ExcelDownload PDF **13** Checkpoints **5** Sections Post-commissioning; annual maintenance audit QC Engineer, Fire Safety Inspector [IS 2189:2018](https://infralens.in/code/IS-2189-1999) [IS 14435:2015](https://infralens.in/code/IS-14435-1997) Related [📐IS 2189](https://infralens.in/code/IS-2189) [✏️Fire Smoke Detector Spacing](https://infralens.in/thumbrules/fire-smoke-detector-spacing) [📘Site Safety Checklist](https://infralens.in/handbook/site-safety-checklist) [📖Min cover for RCC](https://infralens.in/knowledge/minimum-cover-rcc-is-456) [🔧RCC design](https://infralens.in/tools/rcc-design) ### Checklist Preview Expand all ↓ | S.No. | Checkpoint | IS Requirement | Status | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | A. MAIN SUPPLY PRESSURE AND FLOW TEST | | A1 | Static pressure at main inlet measured without flow
Acceptance: Minimum ≥ 3.5 bar; measurement recorded with calibrated gauge; reading taken at stabilized state (≥ 30 seconds) | Cl. 4.1 — Baseline pressure measurement | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A2 | Hydrant #1 outlet flow measured at 3.5 bar minimum outlet pressure
Acceptance: Flow ≥ 20 litres/minute; measured with calibrated flow meter or bucket method (30-second collection); pressure at outlet ≥ 2.8 bar | Cl. 4.2 — Hydrant flow rate | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A3 | Hydrant #2 outlet flow measured simultaneously (if 2-hydrant simultaneous operation required)
Acceptance: Both hydrants flowing; total flow ≥ 40 litres/min combined; pressure at each outlet ≥ 2.5 bar (may drop with simultaneous draw) | Cl. 4.3 — Multiple hydrant operation | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A4 | Pressure drop measured along the system during flow (from inlet to farthest hydrant)
Acceptance: Pressure drop < 1.0 bar for 20 m/min flow; indicates acceptable pipe sizing and friction losses | Cl. 4.4 — Pressure loss assessment | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B. HYDRANT OUTLET AND COUPLING TEST | | B1 | Outlet dimension verified (38 mm standard coupling, ISO/Storz compatible)
Acceptance: Outlet measured 38 mm ± 1 mm; standard fire department hose coupling fits smoothly; no leakage when connected | Cl. 5.1 — Coupling compatibility | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B2 | Nozzle/shut-off valve operation tested under flow and pressure conditions
Acceptance: Nozzle closes smoothly with one-hand operation; no water spray when closed; open/close cycles ≥ 5 with smooth operation | Cl. 5.2 — Valve functionality | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B3 | Water leakage at outlet cap/closure when hydrant not in use
Acceptance: No visible water dripping from outlet; cap seated firmly; gasket condition checked (replace if deteriorated) | Cl. 5.3 — Outlet sealing | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C. HOSE REEL OPERATION TEST | | C1 | Hose reel rotation and extension tested; hose deploys smoothly without kinks or snagging
Acceptance: Reel rotates without binding; hose extends fully without twisting; return mechanism functional (if spring-loaded) | Cl. 6.1 — Reel functionality | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C2 | Hose condition inspection: diameter, length, surface integrity checked for cracks/splits
Acceptance: Hose 25-30 mm diameter; length ≥ 30 m; no visible cracks, splits, or hard spots; pressure-tested at 5 bar (visual only for this test) | Cl. 6.2 — Hose integrity | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C3 | Water spray pattern from nozzle verified (conical/straight stream adjustable if multi-pattern nozzle)
Acceptance: Spray covers minimum 3 m² area at 5 m distance; uniform pattern with no dead spots; adjustment smooth | Cl. 6.3 — Spray pattern | OK
NC
